text: Seal Island there was once famous for great whites leaping clear of the water after seals.
speaker: ryan
about: Qwen3-TTS speaker 'ryan': calm, measured and serious, an even tone, speaking a little slower than his usual pace. Chosen by measurement from many takes and slowed 12% so that lines recorded against it are spoken about 9% slower by the voice itself (no stretching of the lines). Lines keep about 4 semitones of tone movement. Used for scripts whose mood reads as serious.
